name: App style help
description: Help mode entries for the App style settings tab (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Every app's style
entries.text: Each app's design and colours: inherited from axHub, or its own (overriding axHub) with axHub's value beside it. Change an app's own from its Settings → Appearance → axHub style.

entries.title: Reload from axHub
entries.text: Makes every open app re-read axHub's look now. Overrides stay.

entries.title: Follow axHub
entries.text: Turns this app's override off, so it shows axHub's design or colours again.
